CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'Pass@123';

create DATABASE scoped CREDENTIAL cred_swap 
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE SilverDataSource
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://swap01storageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/silver',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_swap
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE GoldDataSource
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'https://swap01storageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/gold',
    CREDENTIAL = cred_swap
)

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)
